Vendored winit 0.30.13 from crates.io, retaining upstream licenses. The local patch adds a copy-only Wayland URI drag source on the existing event queue, using the focused seat and pointer-button serial. Offers are bounded to 1 MiB, receive/send pipe work is bounded by 15-second timeouts, and queued drop events restore the pointer position captured at drop before delivering paths. Superseded offers are destroyed. No source files are moved or deleted.
